thread:
tess: Quick question for docs + infra: I'm assembling a tiny "prefetch quickpatch" entry for the Optimize migration docs. It's meant to be really short (bullet + copyable snippets) for users who hit first-token jitter with q4-family quant profiles.

omar: Good. Can you outline the exact user flow we'll recommend? Keep it minimal so support can paste it.

tess: Plan: 1) one-sentence symptom, 2) two-line mitigation (disable prefetch or use adaptive window), 3) two SDK snippets (py/js), 4) link to smoke job.

elyn: Small ask: add the Console toggle path and a one-line test command users can run locally. e.g., `python examples/prefetch_smoke.py --profile q4_fast`.

tess: Yep. Draft snippet (Python):

```
# short-prefix safe preset
client.optimize.configure(
  model='redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  cache={'prefetch': {'enabled': False}},
  batching={'strategy': 'microbatch', 'max_batch_ms': 10}
)
```

omar: JS equivalent please so we cover both SDKs.

tess: JS snippet: 

```
// short-prefix safe preset
await client.optimize.configure({
  model: 'redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  cache: { prefetch: { enabled: false } },
  batching: { strategy: 'microbatch', maxBatchMs: 10 }
});
```

elyn: For the docs text keep the tone "observed behaviour" -> "recommended mitigation". Avoid implying a product bug. Add a note: "Re-enable adaptive prefetch after rollout if throughput is impacted."

tess: Good. I'll add a tiny decision bullet:

- short-prefix: prefetch=false + microbatch 5-15ms
- long-stream: prefetch=true + continuous batching
- embeddings: prefetch=true (no quant caveat)

omar: Add a single perf link (internal) as artifact: https://internal.redwood/perf/2249-prefetch-quickpatch and mention the CSV attachment.

tess: I'll open PR `docs/prefetch-quickpatch-3219876543` and label it `docs:optimize-quick` + `needs-ml-review`. Will include an examples folder `examples/optimize/prefetch-quickpatch` with a one-shot smoke script.

docs-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/3342 by tess  labels: docs:optimize-quick, needs-ml-review.

elyn: CI note: mark the examples-smoke job flaky-tolerant, timing-sensitive. Also add a tiny assert in the smoke that p95_first_token < 180ms for short-prefix after warmup.

tess: Done. Target merge after 1 ML + 1 Docs sign-off. I'll ping in #eng-ml and #devex when PR is up.

omar: Thanks. If it lands today, please backport a single-line note to the Optimize migration index.

tess: Will do. Closing the loop here.
